<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that breaks an amide back to a carboxylic acid and an amine. In the forward direction this corresponds to breaking a carboxylic acid and forming an amide. Using the available functional groups list, we search the template catalog with functional_groups_broken set to "aliphatic carboxylic acid" and functional_groups_formed set to "amide".</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1", "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"], "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"], "limit": 5}</action_input>
